application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
REAR GARDEN @ NO.7		

T1	Leyland cypress (× Cuprocyparis leylandii)	Tree growing in neighbours garden, close to rear of house - Remove lowest 3 largest diameter branches, cutting back to main stem. Reduce any remaining overhang back towards the boundary, removing approx. 2-3m of growth. 

Reduce height only by 3-4m, in addition to the original spec of cutting back on no.5 side.
Final height unchanged at 8m and final spread 8m. 	

T2	Leyland cypress (× Cuprocyparis leylandii)	Tree growing in neighbours garden, close to corner of garages - Fell to ground level as outgrown location and in poor condition and threatning outbuildings.

T3	Monterey Cypress (Cupressus macrocarpa)	Tree growing in neighbours garden, covered in creeper - Fell to ground level as outgrown location and in poor condition and threatning outbuildings.
